reported.title: Injector pulse is 2000 ms instead of 800 ms
reported.description: Line 7 sets PULSE_MS to 2000, but the spec requires an 800 ms pulse. The pulse-end check on line 79 uses this constant, so every pulse runs 2000 ms; measured pulses lasted 2001 ms and 2000 ms against an expected 800 ± 150 ms. Because the pulse is too long, the !pulsing guard on line 69 also ignores retriggers that should have been accepted after 800 ms. 2 of 2 pulse(s) had the wrong length: pulse from 1.03 s lasted 2000 ms, expected 800 ± 150 ms. A trigger at 2.51 s came during this pulse, which must not change its length.

reported.title: Ready lamp stays LOW for the whole over-long pulse
reported.description: setReady(false) on line 75 and setReady(true) on line 83 tie D12 to the pulse, but the pulse length comes from PULSE_MS on line 7 (2000 ms). D12 therefore stays LOW for 2000 ms while D9 is HIGH, and the checker reports D12 was not HIGH for 2000 ms while required. The lamp logic is correct in structure; the wrong pulse duration makes it fail. D12 was in the wrong state for 6000 ms across 3 interval(s), first at 825 ms: D12 was not HIGH for 2000 ms while required (grace 50 ms).

judge_input.spec:
- Trigger on D4 with INPUT_PULLUP (active LOW); mist injector on D9; ready lamp on D12.
- A settled press as short as 30 ms starts an 800 ms HIGH pulse on D9 within 120 ms.
- Retriggers during an active pulse are ignored.
- Debounce the trigger with 25 ms of stability.
- Keep D12 HIGH when idle and LOW while the injector pulse is active.
- Print `mist shots=<n> busy=<0|1>` every 450 ms.
